title: G-MODEアーカイブス01 フライハイトクラウディア
description:
A JRPG whose story takes place in the sky!A scenario-driven, orthodox RPG in the sky world of Claudia.

The story begins when Reynas, a knight of the great nation of Kaiserschuld, marches on the neighboring island of Badelsen.

In the world of Claudia, she travels between floating islands scattered in a sea of clouds while controlling an airship, and a dramatic scenario with a variety of events unfolds.

A unique battle system (Multi-Weight Battle) that can be easily controlled provides a sense of speed and exhilarating action at the same time. 

You can enjoy powerful battle scenes with magic and special moves full of effects.
description_short: A JRPG whose story takes place in the sky!
